_about: Suggested starting points for the Documentation Builder. Each names a page by catalog id and one or more of its exact ## headings; tools/check-worksheets.mjs fails if a heading here stops matching the page. 'test' is 'desk' (read and edit anywhere, no equipment) or 'hands-on' (where-you-can-do-it labels come from that page's own catalog entry, never from here).
